s1.text: Adult hoodies have no CPSC rule? Wrong.

s2.text: Say a seller launches cotton fleece hoodies for adults. Part sixteen ten covers clothing textiles.

s3.text: Here's the catch. All-polyester fabric skips testing for guaranties. Cotton fleece doesn't.

s4.text: So her G C C lists part sixteen ten, and she checks the fabric test.
